name: financial-analysis
description: Source-bound financial-analysis and due-diligence preparation for Vera.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare source-bound financial analysis and due-diligence evidence.
interface.longDescription: Vera workflow for preparing financial-analysis evidence under explicit dataset, relationship, crosswalk, reconciliation, and reproducibility contracts. It recognizes eight fixed packs: monthly P&L, working capital, customer concentration, Quality of Earnings, net debt, normalized working capital, Capex, and deal bridges, plus reviewed contingent-liability and financial-issue registers. Prepared evidence remains distinct from source tie-out, completeness, deal decisions, professional conclusions, and report-ready claims.
defaultPrompt: Use Vera Financial Analysis on the accounting files I provide.
Choose the relevant operating-analysis or financial due-diligence pack, establish its contracts, and validate the evidence.
Keep accounting judgments explicit and do not present prepared evidence as a professional conclusion.
